title: CLI command framework and output contract
objective: Implement command routing, common flags, text/JSON envelopes, stable exits, non-interactive behavior, and side-effect-free dry-run semantics.
expected_output: CLI command parser and common options
stable JSON/text output and exit code contract
acceptance_criteria: All documented command families parse and return stable status/error envelopes.
JSON mode emits valid JSON only on stdout.
Non-interactive mode never prompts or infers approval.
Dry-run performs inspection only and creates no persistent or remote changes.
undo_classification: Revert only node-owned CLI changes after checking downstream consumers.
retry_policy: Initial attempt plus at most 2 retries; repeated identical failure escalates.
